headline: Taylor Farms Pulls Salsa and Guacamole Over Salmonella Concerns
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Taylor Farms is pulling more than a dozen prepared food items containing jalapeños, including salsas and guacamole, from retailers due to concerns over salmonella, just weeks after federal health officials tied the produce company to a separate outbreak of cyclospora.Most Read from BloombergTrump Amps Up Pressure on Billionaire Sargeant to Exit VenezuelaIran Rejects US Talks as Trump Displays Patience for Hormuz DealIran Says Hormuz Deal Close But Its Conditions Must Be MetOpenAI’
